## Change

What changed, and why?

## Boundary

Does this affect simulation, presentation, documentation or the proposed protocol? Do not describe planned cryptography as implemented.

Does organism behavior change? Does simulation state or storage compatibility change?

## Visual evidence

For visual changes, include screenshots/recordings without personal browser tabs, account details or secrets. Identify the active or experimental renderer.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Relevant browser tests / `npm test`
- [ ] Desktop, touch and keyboard behavior considered
- [ ] No secrets, local-machine paths or unverifiable capability claims
- [ ] State / identity invariants and documentation reviewed

Include test commands and results. For protocol-sensitive changes, explain versioning and compatibility.
